commands.name: CopyIflowDevToQas
commands.description: Rota DIRECT. Baixa a versão informada do iFlow no CPI DEV e cria ou atualiza o iFlow no CPI QAS, tudo pela OData API pública do Cloud Integration. Não usa cTMS. O pacote precisa existir em QAS.

packageId.description: ID técnico do pacote em QAS (usado só se o iFlow ainda não existir)

result.description: Linhas de saída do script (OK CREATE|UPDATE ...)

input.script:
import sys, json, base64, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error, os
art, ver, pkg = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
dev_secret = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
qas_secret = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
E = os.environ
dev = {"api": E["DEV_API"], "tok": E["DEV_TOKEN_URL"], "id": E["DEV_CLIENT_ID"], "sec": dev_secret}
qas = {"api": E["QAS_API"], "tok": E["QAS_TOKEN_URL"], "id": E["QAS_CLIENT_ID"], "sec": qas_secret}
def token(c):
    req = urllib.request.Request(c["tok"], data=b"grant_type=client_credentials", method="POST")
    req.add_header("Authorization", "Basic " + base64.b64encode((c["id"] + ":" + c["sec"]).encode()).decode())
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        return json.load(r)["access_token"]
def call(c, tok, method, path, body=None, accept="application/json"):
    data = None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(c["api"].rstrip("/") + path, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + tok)
    req.add_header("Accept", accept)
    if data is not None:
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:
            return r.status, r.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.read()
q = lambda s: urllib.parse.quote(s, safe="")
td, tq = token(dev), token(qas)
path_dev = "/api/v1/IntegrationDesigntimeArtifacts(Id='%s',Version='%s')" % (q(art), q(ver))
st, zipb = call(dev, td, "GET", path_dev + "/$value", accept="application/zip")
if st != 200:
    print("ERRO_DOWNLOAD_DEV", st, zipb[:400].decode("utf-8", "replace"))
    sys.exit(2)
content = base64.b64encode(zipb).decode()
path_qas = "/api/v1/IntegrationDesigntimeArtifacts(Id='%s',Version='active')" % q(art)
st, meta = call(qas, tq, "GET", path_qas)
if st == 200:
    name = json.loads(meta).get("d", {}).get("Name", art)
    st, b = call(qas, tq, "PUT", path_qas, {"Name": name, "ArtifactContent": content})
    action = "UPDATE"
else:
    st, b = call(qas, tq, "POST", "/api/v1/IntegrationDesigntimeArtifacts",
                 {"Name": art, "Id": art, "PackageId": pkg, "ArtifactContent": content})
    action = "CREATE"
if st not in (200, 201, 202, 204):
    print("ERRO_UPLOAD_QAS", action, st, b[:400].decode("utf-8", "replace"))
    sys.exit(3)
print("OK", action, art, ver, len(zipb))
